_descriptor_type: A type of descriptor. One of 'simulation', 'trace', and 'perf'.
_architecture: A name of the available architectures (PARAMS.<architecture>) found in scarab repository, which defines the machine parameters of the default configuration.
_experiment: The name of the experiment. scarab-infra will create a new folder named containing all files needed to execute the simulation in the <ROOT_DIR>/simulations/<experiment> directory. The folder will also contain all generated simulation statistics/outputs.
_workload_manager: manual: run each exp scenario with all the simpoints at a time, slurm: Slurm schedules simulations based on its policy
_root_dir: Root directory mounted into the docker container home, for instance, the user's home directory
_application_dir: The path to the benchmark application directory used for tracing or simulation.
_scarab_path: The path to the scarab repository that contains the scarab binary used to run the experiment. REQUIRES a build containing REPL_MOCKINGJAY (--mlc_cache_repl_policy 22 and the --mockingjay_* knobs); a stock build will silently fall back on an unknown ordinal. That same build also contains the mlc_fill_line ordering fix (victim selection + writeback now run BEFORE cache_insert, as they already did in l1_fill_line), which changes MLC writeback traffic and per-line fill metadata for EVERY L2 replacement policy -- so the baseline / static_i48d32 / setduel_g8 numbers here are NOT comparable to the earlier td_offpath_l2 run and must be re-baselined within this experiment.
_traces_dir: The local directory containing all simpointed traces
_top_simpoint: Run only top 3 simpoints stored in 'workloads_top_simp.json'.
_simulations: Offshoot of td_offpath_l2 that puts the marked-RRIP L2 configs head-to-head with (a) the stock RRIP-family policies SRRIP/DRRIP/SHIP and (b) Mockingjay (HPCA'22), all on the L2 (MLC) via --mlc_cache_repl_policy <ordinal> (the Repl_Policy enum in src/libs/cache_lib.h). Mockingjay predicts a per-PC reuse distance and keeps a per-line Estimated Time Remaining, evicting the largest |ETR|; it also declines to allocate a fill whose predicted reuse beats every resident line. Its sampler and signature widths are derived from CACHE CAPACITY using the paper's LLC-oriented formulas, which undersize badly on this 256KB 8-way L2 -- log2(sampled sets) = log2(bytes)-16 = 2 (only 4 of 512 sets sampled, 320 sampler entries) and signature width = log2(bytes)-10 = 8 bits (256 RDP entries), versus 32 sampled sets / 11 bits on the paper's 2MB 16-way LLC. The mj_samp* / mj_sig* configs sweep those two axes independently and mj_l2_tuned combines them, so a weak mj_default can be attributed to undersizing rather than to the policy. mj_*_nobypass isolates the bypass contribution (and is the safe fallback if the bypass wiring in mlc_fill_line misbehaves). Compare IPC / MLC_DEMAND_MISS / DCACHE_MISS_LD vs. baseline.
_configurations: baseline = untouched L2 (default MLC_CACHE_REPL_POLICY = 0 = REPL_TRUE_LRU). static_i48d32 / setduel_g8 are carried over unchanged from td_offpath_l2 as the marked-RRIP reference points. repl_* force one stock policy on the L2 (16=SRRIP, 18=DRRIP, 19=SHIP). mj_* force Mockingjay (22): mj_default uses the capacity-derived sizing (log2_sampled_sets=2, pc_signature_bits=8); mj_samp{4,6} widen the sampler to 16 / 64 sampled sets (1280 / 5120 entries); mj_sig{11,14} widen the RDP to 2K / 16K entries (11 = the paper's LLC width); mj_l2_tuned combines the widest of both. mj_nobypass and mj_l2_tuned_nobypass repeat those two with --mockingjay_bypass 0 so the bypass contribution can be separated from victim selection. On this L2 (8-way, history 8, granularity 8) the derived scale is INF_RD=63, INF_ETR=7, MAX_RD=41.

baseline._params: Untouched machine (default L2 replacement policy, REPL_TRUE_LRU).

static_i48d32._params: Carried over from td_offpath_l2: combined static at the balanced i48d32 bin (instr -48, data -32, both at suite max); no dueling.

setduel_g8._params: Carried over from td_offpath_l2: set dueling, window 100k, 8 leader sets per group (24 total leaders).

repl_srrip._params: REPL_SRRIP (16) -- static re-reference interval prediction. The unmarked parent of the td_* marked-RRIP configs.

repl_drrip._params: REPL_DRRIP (18) -- dynamic (set-dueling) RRIP. The stock-policy counterpart to setduel_g8.

repl_ship._params: REPL_SHIP (19) -- signature-based hit predictor. The closest stock analogue to Mockingjay (PC-signature-driven insertion), so the mj_* gain over this isolates reuse-distance prediction from plain signature-based insertion.

mj_default._params: REPL_MOCKINGJAY (22) with the paper's capacity-derived sizing: 4 sampled sets of 512 (320 sampler entries), 8-bit signature (256 RDP entries), bypass on. The reference point -- expect it to be sampler-starved on a 256KB L2.

mj_nobypass._params: mj_default with fill bypass disabled -- victim selection (largest |ETR|) only. Isolates how much of Mockingjay's effect comes from declining to allocate, and is the fallback if the bypass path in mlc_fill_line misbehaves.

mj_samp4._params: Sampler axis: 16 sampled sets of 512 (1280 sampler entries), signature left at the derived 8 bits.

mj_samp6._params: Sampler axis: 64 sampled sets of 512 (5120 sampler entries), signature left at the derived 8 bits.

mj_sig11._params: Signature axis: 11-bit signature (2048 RDP entries) -- the width the paper's 2MB LLC derives -- with the sampler left at the derived 4 sets.

mj_sig14._params: Signature axis: 14-bit signature (16384 RDP entries), sampler left at the derived 4 sets. Tests whether 8-bit signature aliasing is the binding constraint.

mj_l2_tuned._params: Both axes widened: 64 sampled sets + 14-bit signature, bypass on. The upper bound for what sizing can buy on this L2.

mj_l2_tuned_nobypass._params: mj_l2_tuned with fill bypass disabled -- bypass contribution measured at the tuned sizing rather than the starved default.

_collect_stats: Stats collection settings for ./sci --collect-stats. configs: optional list of configuration names to collect (null or omitted = all configurations).
_visualize: Visualization settings for ./sci --visualize. IPC is the target-only (post-warmup, Periodic_*) figure, matching td_offpath_l2 -- do NOT mix it with the Cumulative_*-derived IPC_total. MLC_DEMAND_MISS is the L2 demand-miss count this experiment is actually steering.
_mem: Memory scheduling and collection settings for Slurm jobs.
